source.description: Archive of ransomware ransom notes — mapped to Ransomchats actors for early attribution (T+0). Notes are not vendored; links only.

note_phrases_pt: internal infrastructure... fully or partially dead
note_phrases_en: internal infrastructure... fully or partially dead
Akira.chat_continuity_pt: Mesma persona de suporte técnico; a nota anuncia exfiltração e destruição de backups antes do portal de chat.
Akira.chat_continuity_en: Same technical-support persona; the note announces exfiltration and backup destruction before the chat portal.

Avaddon.chat_continuity_pt: Tom agressivo da nota evolui para sarcasmo e *Tick tock* no chat.
Avaddon.chat_continuity_en: Aggressive note tone escalates to sarcasm and *Tick tock* in chat.

note_phrases_pt: do not shutting down your computer
note_phrases_en: do not shutting down your computer
Avos.chat_continuity_pt: Nota formal de AvosLocker; chat separa Staff central e affiliate RaaS.
Avos.chat_continuity_en: Formal AvosLocker note; chat separates central Staff and RaaS affiliate.

Babuk.extension_or_artifact: .babuk (conhecido em CTI; sem nota no ThreatLabz)
Babuk.chat_continuity_pt: Sem entrada no ThreatLabz — use *Technical support is ready* e perguntas sobre seguro no chat.
Babuk.chat_continuity_en: No ThreatLabz entry — use *Technical support is ready* and insurance screening in chat.

note_phrases_pt: Your data are stolen and encrypted
note_phrases_en: Your data are stolen and encrypted
BlackBasta.chat_continuity_pt: Nota direta sobre portal Tor; chat adota framing *businessman* e piso ~$150K.
BlackBasta.chat_continuity_en: Direct Tor portal note; chat adopts *businessman* framing and ~$150K floor.

BlackMatter.chat_continuity_pt: Arte ASCII da nota; chat mantém sarcasmo e conhecimento de infra em tempo real.
BlackMatter.chat_continuity_en: ASCII art in note; chat keeps sarcasm and real-time infra awareness.

note_phrases_pt: network is hacked and files are encrypted
note_phrases_en: network is hacked and files are encrypted
Cloak.chat_continuity_pt: Nota lista exfiltração; chat impõe 6 regras + 11 passos antes do preço.
Cloak.chat_continuity_en: Note lists exfiltration; chat enforces 6 rules + 11 steps before pricing.

note_phrases_pt: cannot be recovered... without contacting our team
note_phrases_en: cannot be recovered... without contacting our team
Conti.chat_continuity_pt: Nota jurídica inicial; chat expande contrato, seguro cyber e escada de preços.
Conti.chat_continuity_en: Initial legal note; chat expands contract, cyber insurance, and price ladder.

Darkside.chat_continuity_pt: Nota fria e direta; chat escala com OSINT financeiro e ameaças à imprensa.
Darkside.chat_continuity_en: Cold direct note; chat escalates with financial OSINT and media threats.

note_phrases_pt: files have been stolen... and encrypted
note_phrases_en: files have been stolen... and encrypted
Dragonforce.chat_continuity_pt: Nota estruturada em passos; chat ancora em BTC com timer de 2 semanas.
Dragonforce.chat_continuity_en: Structured step-based note; chat anchors on BTC with 2-week timer.

fog.chat_continuity_pt: Nota minimalista com identidade Fog; chat mantém abertura *hi* e delegação aos *bosses*.
fog.chat_continuity_en: Minimal note with Fog identity; chat keeps *hi* opening and *bosses* delegation.

Hive.chat_continuity_pt: Nota padrão de leak site; chat formal *How may I help you?* com recusa a SMBs downstream.
Hive.chat_continuity_en: Standard leak-site note; formal *How may I help you?* chat refusing downstream SMBs.

note_phrases_pt: large amount of sensitive data was exfiltrated
note_phrases_en: large amount of sensitive data was exfiltrated
Hunters International.chat_continuity_pt: Nota ultimato; chat confirma inflexibilidade (*I'm okay to get nothing*).
Hunters International.chat_continuity_en: Ultimatum note; chat confirms inflexibility (*I'm okay to get nothing*).

note_phrases_pt: Your data is stolen and encrypted
note_phrases_en: Your data is stolen and encrypted
lockbit3.0.chat_continuity_pt: Nota branding LockBit 3.0; chat reduz tudo a *hello! pay for key!*.
lockbit3.0.chat_continuity_en: LockBit 3.0 branding note; chat reduces to *hello! pay for key!*.

note_phrases_pt: files are encrypted and can not be used
Do not try to change or restore files yourself
note_phrases_en: files are encrypted and can not be used
Do not try to change or restore files yourself

Mallox.chat_continuity_en: Note offers site test decrypt; chat uses BOT with automatic % discount.

mount-locker.extension_or_artifact: .mount-locker (conhecido em CTI; sem nota no ThreatLabz)
mount-locker.chat_continuity_pt: Sem entrada no ThreatLabz — use framework legal e *Greetings! We are ready to help you!* no chat.
mount-locker.chat_continuity_en: No ThreatLabz entry — use legal framework and *Greetings! We are ready to help you!* in chat.

DO NOT USE THIRD PARTY SOFTWARE

Nightspire.chat_continuity_en: 3-day deadline note; chat escalates with 10-K filing OSINT and FBI mentions.

NoEscape.chat_continuity_pt: Nota formal com ID pessoal; chat polido com test decrypt via portal.
NoEscape.chat_continuity_en: Formal note with personal ID; polished chat with portal test decrypt.

Pear.chat_continuity_en: No ThreatLabz entry — use numbered conditions (a–e) and *non-negotiable* in chat.

Qilin.chat_continuity_pt: Nota estilo Akira-like; chat oferece 7 entregáveis e ameaça venda a fisco.
Qilin.chat_continuity_en: Akira-like note style; chat offers 7 deliverables and tax-authority sale threat.

note_phrases_en: Your data is stolen and encrypted

RansomHub.chat_continuity_en: Note is FAQ template; only captured chat is also automated template.

Ranzy.chat_continuity_pt: Nota minimalista por e-mail; chat confirma preço fixo $7K sem double extortion.
Ranzy.chat_continuity_en: Minimal email-based note; chat confirms fixed $7K price without double extortion.

REvil.chat_continuity_pt: Nota estruturada em FAQ; chat torna-se condescendente e refuta com docs roubados.
REvil.chat_continuity_en: FAQ-structured note; chat becomes condescending and refutes with stolen docs.

RunSomeWares.extension_or_artifact: .RSW (conhecido em CTI; sem nota no ThreatLabz)
RunSomeWares.chat_continuity_pt: Sem entrada no ThreatLabz — use *We analized the company's revenue* e tom cooperativo no chat.
RunSomeWares.chat_continuity_en: No ThreatLabz entry — use *We analized the company's revenue* and cooperative tone in chat.

trinity.chat_continuity_pt: Nota com portal Tor/e-mail; chat cobra 0,25 BTC por endpoint sem flexibilidade.
trinity.chat_continuity_en: Tor/email portal note; chat charges 0.25 BTC per endpoint with no flexibility.
